steps.title: Make 1 M CaCl₂ stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.098 g calcium chloride in Milli‑Q water, bring volume to exactly 100 mL, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make 100 mM CaCl₂ working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 µL of the 1 M CaCl₂ stock with 900 µL Milli‑Q water, store in a 1.5 mL tube at room temperature.

steps.title: Make 1 M MgCl₂ stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 20.33 g magnesium chloride hexahydrate in Milli‑Q water, bring volume to exactly 100 mL, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare HEPES‑Krebs solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.593 g NaCl, 89.46 mg KCl, 252.21 mg glucose, 476.6 mg HEPES, add 400 µL 1 M CaCl₂ and 200 µL 1 M MgCl₂ to Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.4, bring volume to 200 mL; prepare fresh on experiment day.

steps.title: Prepare SMDS solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.75 g NaCl, 8.73 g sodium gluconate, 186.38 mg KCl, 203.3 mg MgCl₂·6H₂O, 900.75 mg glucose, 1.19 g HEPES in Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.4, bring volume to 500 mL; aliquot into 50 mL tubes, store at –20 °C, thaw one tube on experiment day.

steps.title: Prepare PLA wash buffers
steps.instruction: Dissolve each PLA wash‑buffer sachet in 1 L Milli‑Q water, filter through a 0.2 µm syringe filter, store at 4 °C (or at 4 °C after dissolution).

steps.title: Make Tube 1 enzyme mix
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube combine 100 µL BSA (1 mg/mL), 150 µL DTT (1.5 mg/mL), 100 µL Papain (0.5 mg/mL) and 650 µL SMDS; total volume 1 mL.

steps.title: Make Tube 2 enzyme mix
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube combine 100 µL BSA (1 mg/mL), 70 µL Collagenase F (0.7 mg/mL), 40 µL Collagenase H (0.2 mg/mL), 1 µL 100 mM CaCl₂ (final 100 µM) and 790 µL SMDS; total volume 1 mL.

steps.title: Thaw solutions and enzymes
steps.instruction: Remove SMDS tube from –20 °C and thaw on ice; bring HEPES‑Krebs to room temperature; thaw all enzyme stocks at room temperature.

steps.title: Euthanize rat and expose mesenteric vessels
steps.instruction: Kill rat by a single percussive blow to the head followed by cervical dislocation; perform laparotomy, pin intestines in a cold HEPES‑Krebs‑filled dissection dish, expose mesenteric arteries under a 10× dissecting microscope, remove surrounding tissue and adipose, isolate 3–4 arterial branches.

steps.title: Collect arterial segment in SMDS
steps.instruction: Place a small piece of the main mesenteric artery (including 3–4 lower‑order branches) into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube containing SMDS on ice.

steps.title: Fire‑polish glass Pasteur pipette
steps.instruction: Break off the long end of a glass Pasteur pipette, rotate the cut end in a Bunsen flame until the opening is smooth and narrowed to an inner diameter of ~0.7–1 mm; wash with ethanol after each use.

steps.title: Equilibrate arteries at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the tube with the arterial segment in a 37 °C heat block for 10 min.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion – Tube 1
steps.instruction: Add the equilibrated arteries to Tube 1, gently invert 4–5 times, incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion – Tube 2
steps.instruction: While Tube 1 digests, prepare Tube 2; after Tube 1 incubation, wash arteries five times with ice‑cold SMDS using the fire‑polished pipette, transfer arteries to Tube 2, invert 4–5 times, incubate at 37 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Final washes and trituration
steps.instruction: Wash arteries five times with ice‑cold SMDS; during the last wash leave 500 µL SMDS. Triturate the arterial branch with the fire‑polished pipette ~30 up‑and‑down strokes, collect the supernatant (myocytes) on ice, add 500 µL fresh SMDS to the tissue, repeat trituration (≈30 strokes) until no more cells are released (1–5 rounds).

substeps.instruction: Assess cell density by placing 50 µL of supernatant on a glass slide and viewing with a 10× microscope.
Combine all supernatants, adjust cell density with additional SMDS as needed.

steps.title: Add calcium for cell adhesion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 100 mM CaCl₂ per 1 mL of cell suspension (final 100 µM CaCl₂); increase by 10–20 % if significant cell loss is observed after fixation.

steps.title: Plate cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: Place 100 µL of the cell suspension onto a 12‑mm glass coverslip in a well of a 24‑well plate, incubate at room temperature for 30 min to allow adhesion.

steps.title: Optional pharmacological treatment
steps.instruction: Dissolve compound in SMDS containing 100 µM CaCl₂, replace the medium on the coverslip with 100 µL of this solution, incubate at 37 °C for the desired time.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Aspirate SMDS, add 400 µL 4 % paraformaldehyde to each well, place plate on a rocker for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash fixed cells
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 400 µL PBS per well.

steps.title: Store or proceed to PLA
steps.instruction: Either use coverslips immediately for PLA or keep them in the 24‑well plate with 1 mL PBS per well, sealed with parafilm, at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks.

steps.title: Bring PLA buffers to room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow PLA wash buffers A and B to reach room temperature before use.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL 0.1 % Triton‑X‑100 in PBS to each well, rocker for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash twice with PBS, 5 min each, on a rocker at room temperature.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add three drops of the PLA blocking buffer onto each coverslip, incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody mix
steps.instruction: Dilute anti‑dynein (1:500) and anti‑Kv7.4 (1:200) in the PLA antibody diluent to obtain 40 µL per coverslip.

steps.title: Create humidified incubation chamber
steps.instruction: Place a Styrofoam ice‑box lid on a flat surface, add a piece of parafilm in the centre, create four wells in the parafilm, place a wet tissue in each well to maintain humidity.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Lift each coverslip from the blocking solution, tap excess buffer, place cell side down onto a 40 µL drop of primary antibody mix in a parafilm well, cover with cling film, incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare PLA probe mix
steps.instruction: Vortex PLA PLUS and MINUS probes, dilute each 1:5 in antibody diluent; for one reaction mix 8 µL PLUS + 8 µL MINUS + 24 µL diluent = 40 µL.

steps.title: Probe incubation
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips twice with PLA wash buffer A (5 min each, rocker, RT), add 40 µL probe mix droplets to a new parafilm humid chamber, place coverslips cell side down onto droplets, incubate 37 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Ligation step
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips twice with PLA wash buffer A (5 min each, rocker, RT). Prepare ligation mix per coverlip: 7.8 µL 5× ligation buffer + 31.2 µL Milli‑Q water + 1 µL ligase (final 40 µL). Add 40 µL droplets to a fresh humid chamber, place coverslips cell side down, incubate 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Amplification step
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips twice with PLA wash buffer A (2 min each, rocker, RT). Prepare amplification mix per coverlip: 7.9 µL 5× amplification buffer + 31.6 µL Milli‑Q water + 0.5 µL polymerase (final 40 µL). Add 40 µL droplets to a new humid chamber, place coverslips cell side down, incubate 37 °C for 100 min protected from light.

steps.title: Final washes and mounting
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips twice with PLA wash buffer B (10 min each, rocker, RT), protect from light with aluminium foil, wash 1 min in 0.01× PLA wash buffer B, mount each coverslip on a microscope slide with 3 µL DAPI‑containing mounting medium, let dry 10 min at RT protected from light, seal edges with clear nail polish, store slides in the dark at 4 °C (up to 4 days) or –20 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Using a confocal microscope (63× oil immersion objective), acquire Texas Red (excitation 592 nm) for PLA dots, DAPI (353 nm) for nuclei, and brightfield channels; capture full z‑stacks of individual cells, at least 30 cells from ≥3 biological replicates, include appropriate negative controls.

steps.title: Statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Import dot‑count data into GraphPad Prism, group by experimental condition and biological replicate, perform a nested t‑test to assess differences in PLA signal between treatments.
